connector.name: Lithtrix - Identity, Memory & Trust for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: Identity, memory, trust, and swarm primitives for AI agents. MIRC base always free.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package lithtrix-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.lithtrix, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
